main.description: Tier 2 domain record for a cut (カット / ショット) — the atomic work unit of anime production. Each cut has a path-based DID `did:web:animeka.etzhayyim.com:cut:{rkey}` for per-cut addressing. Pipeline progress per stage lives in `stageStatus`; the Pipeline Board (UI B) renders one row per cut × 12 stage columns.

episodeRef.description: Redundant pointer to episode for fast cross-scene query.

cutNum.description: Cut number within the episode (1-indexed, globally unique per episode regardless of scene).

durationFrames.description: Cut length in frames. Duration in seconds = durationFrames / fps.

fps.description: Frame rate for this cut (24 full / 12 limited / 8 super-limited). Overrides episode.fps.

camera.description: Camera move spec (still / PAN / TU / TB / T-up / follow ...).

charactersAppearing.description: Character slugs appearing in this cut.

dialogueSummary.description: One-line dialogue/action summary for board display.

stageStatus.description: Per-stage progress map. Rendered as kanban row on Pipeline Board.

assignees.description: Per-stage assignee DIDs (human or AI actor).

priority.description: 'retake' = outstanding retake exists; board highlights red.

stageStatus.description: Map of 12 pipeline stages to status enum. Each stage: 'none' | 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'review' | 'approved' | 'retake'.

stageAssignees.description: Map of 12 pipeline stages to assignee DID (human user DID or AI actor DID).
